cues.en: Tokenized stocks and ETFs now represent over three billion dollars onchain worldwide.
cues.zh: 全球代币化股票与 ETF 的链上规模已超过三十亿美元。

cues.en: In September alone, Solana processed around four point four billion dollars in tokenized stock trades.
cues.zh: 仅九月，Solana 上的代币化股票交易量就达到约四十四亿美元。

cues.en: How can long-term holders participate in that activity?
cues.zh: 长期持有者，怎样参与这些交易？

cues.en: Meet ValueRange. AI turns company valuation into a plan for tokenized stocks on Solana.
cues.zh: 认识 ValueRange：用 AI，把公司估值变成 Solana 股票代币的持仓策略。

cues.en: Keep shares for growth. Put part of the portfolio into AMM liquidity to convert shares and cash, and earn trading fees.
cues.zh: 保留股票参与上涨，用部分资金提供 AMM 流动性，转换股票与现金，赚取交易手续费。

cues.en: The challenge: which ranges, how much capital, and when to adjust?
cues.zh: 难点是：区间怎么定，资金怎么配，什么时候调整？

cues.en: Every company creates value differently. Financial reports and research become a model built around its business.
cues.zh: 每家公司的价值创造方式不同。财报与研究，转化为贴合公司业务的估值模型。

cues.en: AI combines that valuation with market data, current holdings, and your goals.
cues.zh: AI 将估值与市场数据、现有仓位和持有目标结合。

cues.en: Core manages a broad range. Active converts shares in stages. Cash preserves flexibility. Code checks the numbers; you review the plan.
cues.zh: Core 管理宽区间，Active 分段换仓，现金保留灵活性。程序核算，你来复核。

cues.en: Follow a five-year simulation, starting with ten thousand dollars and a share price of ninety-two dollars and two cents.
cues.zh: 看一段五年模拟：本金一万美元，起始股价九十二点零二美元。

cues.en: On the rallies, the strategy converts shares into cash. On the pullbacks, available cash rebuilds inventory.
cues.zh: 上涨时，策略逐步把股票转为现金；回落时，可用现金重新积累股票。

cues.en: Across two market cycles, the mix of shares, cash, and liquidity changes. In-range trading earns fees along the way.
cues.zh: 经历两轮上涨与回落，股票、现金与流动性的比例持续变化，区间内成交累积手续费。

cues.en: This exchanges some upside exposure for fees and range management.
cues.zh: 策略让出部分上涨敞口，换取手续费与区间管理的机会。

cues.en: At the end of year four, positive business news supports stronger growth and profitability.
cues.zh: 第四年末，新的经营利好支持更强的增长与盈利。

cues.en: AI reviews the evidence, updates the valuation, and proposes new liquidity ranges.
cues.zh: AI 复核依据，更新估值中枢，并提出新的流动性区间。

cues.en: Core moves higher. Seventy percent of strategy principal goes to direct shares, and the old Active position is paused.
cues.zh: Core 区间上移，策略本金的百分之七十配置为直接持股，并暂停原有 Active 仓位。

cues.en: The plan responds to the company, instead of keeping yesterday’s ranges forever.
cues.zh: 策略跟随公司变化，不再始终沿用过去的区间。

cues.en: Five years later, the share price reaches two hundred and fifty-one dollars.
cues.zh: 五年结束，股价来到二百五十一美元。

cues.en: The revised portfolio reaches about sixty-six thousand nine hundred dollars, versus twenty-seven thousand three hundred from simply holding shares.
cues.zh: 修正后的组合约六万六千九百美元，纯持股约两万七千三百美元。

cues.en: That is about thirty-nine thousand six hundred dollars more, on the same price path.
cues.zh: 在同一条价格路径上，组合比纯持股多约三万九千六百美元。

cues.en: Nearly four thousand dollars in trading fees are already included. The rest reflects holdings and range decisions.
cues.zh: 其中已包含近四千美元交易手续费，其余差额来自持仓与区间决策。

cues.en: Keeping the original strategy finishes at about forty-one thousand five hundred dollars.
cues.zh: 维持原策略，期末资产约四万一千五百美元。

cues.en: The workflow keeps reviewing news, financial reports, and portfolio records.
cues.zh: 工作流持续复核新闻、财报与仓位记录。

cues.en: Track asset value. Explain the return. Feed the findings into the next strategy review.
cues.zh: 记录净值，拆解收益，把发现反馈到下一轮策略复核。

cues.en: Research, decisions, and revisions remain traceable.
cues.zh: 研究、决策与修正，都保留可追溯的依据。

cues.en: Next, bring this strategy to more people.
cues.zh: 下一步，让更多人用上这套策略。

cues.en: Deposit into a managed vault, with the strategy run for you.
cues.zh: 通过策略金库存入资金，由金库代为管理策略。

cues.en: Or keep custody, with an agent helping you trade within limits you set.
cues.zh: 也可以保留自托管，让 Agent 在你设定的权限内协助交易。

cues.en: Research   Allocate   Adapt
cues.zh: 研究   配置   持续修正

cues.en: ValueRange — A plan for how you hold
cues.zh: ValueRange，让持有更有章法
